tool.description: Compress a file (or any bytes) into an LZMA .xz file, returned for download. .xz (LZMA2) usually achieves a smaller size than gzip or zip at the cost of speed — use it when maximum compression ratio matters. level sets the LZMA preset 0-9 (default 6; higher = smaller but slower and more memory). The output is a standard .xz stream named <input>.xz that any xz / 7-Zip tool can decompress. Provide the file as either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call).

url.description: File URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

level.description: LZMA preset 0-9 (0 = fastest, 9 = smallest; default 6). Higher uses more time and memory.
